text: 中科曙光副总裁曹振南在2026中国算力大会主论坛上披露，国家超算互联网注册用户量已突破170万，累计完成作业量突破2.7亿个，国产算力占比超95%。曹振南介绍，国家超算互联网平台已汇聚CPU核心超350万、GPU卡超25万，日均作业数突破30万个，峰值突破100万个。平台应用商城入驻商户超880家，下单量超24万，覆盖科研创新、人工智能、工业仿真等领域。（界面）
text_en: Cao Zhennan, Vice President of Sugon, disclosed at the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Power Conference that the National Supercomputing Internet has surpassed 1.7 million registered users, with cumulative completed jobs exceeding 270 million, and domestic computing power accounting for over 95%. Cao Zhennan introduced that the National Supercomputing Internet platform has aggregated over 3.5 million CPU cores and over 250,000 GPU cards, with daily average jobs exceeding 300,000 and peak exceeding 1 million. The platform's application marketplace has over 880 merchants, with over 240,000 orders, covering scientific research and innovation, artificial intelligence, industrial simulation and other fields. (Jiemian)
